question: With two overlapping Shapes, does Arrange open, and does its row stay lit while the pointer is on its submenu? Each row's background by label.
note: Two overlapping Shapes (2 blocks read): Arrange opens, and its row stays lit (rgb(242, 242, 242), not :hover) while the pointer is on Move backward and then Move to back; the row under the pointer is lit too. With the menu open and the pointer off it, no row is lit. On the newest block Move forward and Move to front have grey text (rgb(183, 183, 183)). The menu was closed by Copy Properties > Transforms, with the clipboard stubbed (this run: 1 writeText, no readText; CAP-U11LIT: 3 writeText, no readText).
